subject: Create .env bootstrap script for quick onboarding and worktree support
description:
Clean up the local .env setup so new developers (and git worktrees) can get started quickly. Create a script that:
- Resets .env to beta environment defaults from deploy/env/
- Pre-populates local-specific overrides at the top (DB host, ports, etc.)
- Works seamlessly with git worktrees (no manual .env copying)
- Possibly uses .env.example as a template with a setup script that fills in values
- Add instructions to README or HOW_TO_DEV_LOCAL.md
